newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to further ease West Bank, Gaza closure.
newsitem.headline: Israel to further ease West Bank, Gaza closure.

text.p: The Israeli army will further ease a closure order over the West Bank and Gaza Strip, increasing the number of Palestinian workers eligible to enter Israel from 35,000 to 50,000, an army spokeswoman said on Saturday.

Palestinians have complained bitterly over Israel's protracted sealing-off of the PLO-ruled areas, denouncing the closures as collective punishment that has crippled the already battered economies of the West Bank and Gaza.

"Effective Sunday morning at 0400 (0200 GMT), an additional 15,000 workers will be permitted entry, added to 35,000 already permitted entry a week ago," the spokeswoman said. All eligible workers must be married and at least 30 years old, she said.
An additional 500 merchants will also be allowed entry, raising the total number of eligible merchants to 2,250.
Some 60,000 West Bank and Gaza Palestinians worked in the Jewish state before a wave of Moslem suicide bombings in February and March prompted Israel to bar the labourers.
The number allowed in has since fluctuated according to Israeli security and political considerations.
It was unclear how long it would take before Israel completed security checks and issued work permits to the 15,000 labourers and 500 merchants, military sources said.
